records.title: QLoRA vs. LoRA: An Empirical Study of Performance–Efficiency Trade-offs in Fine-Tuning Mistral‑7B on Instruction‑Following Data
records.reason: The study compares QLoRA and LoRA fine-tuning performance/efficiency. Its efficiency target is training, which is outside the stated inference scope.

records.title: Point Diffusion Mamba: Unified Diffusion-State-Space Modeling for Single-View 3D Reconstruction under Data Scarcity
records.reason: Point Diffusion Mamba targets single-view 3D reconstruction with a diffusion/state-space model, not LLM inference/serving.

records.title: AkasicMEM: Governed Enterprise Memory for Agents
records.reason: AkasicMEM is an enterprise agent memory governance system; the abstract does not describe LLM inference-cost or serving optimization.

records.title: Direct Optimization of Generators for Search in Automated Theorem Proving
records.reason: Direct generator optimization changes training objectives for automated theorem-proving search success at a fixed search budget; it does not reduce LLM inference resources.

records.title: How Strongly Should Task State Influence an LLM Agent?
records.reason: The paper studies how task state affects agent reliability and behavior; no inference-efficiency method or measurement is described.
